items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: In my bands... Danny's been with you for a long time

ctx.x: That's what I told Danny, he had no finesse. Earlier he did, but he didn't developed it. Now he has no finesse unless he gets back to his old self.

Because it seemed to me that some of the things that you made the players deal with on the bandstand were very, very difficult, and in order to surmount the complex kinds of structures that you had people play on, that they really had to -- that's probably why they learned so much, from having to deal with that.
